scripts.client:prepare: cd packages/rwa_api_client && dart pub get && dart run build_runner build
scripts.client:regenerate: npm run client:generate && npm run client:prepare && npm run quality:check
scripts.contract:check: npm run contract:test && npm run contract:rules && npm run contract:lint && npm run contract:validate && npm run fixture:check && npm run client:check
scripts.quality:check: npm run contract:check && npm run client:prepare && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test && dart analyze --fatal-infos && flutter test
